findings.highlight: I’ll go to the shopping district
findings.evidenceJa: サッと商店街まで行って、サッと帰ってくればいい
findings.governingReading: he need only dash to the shopping district and dash back
findings.explanation: Both speed and the planned immediate return disappear.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s going to be staying over for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が泊まるようになったんだから
findings.governingReading: now that Sakura has begun staying over
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “for a while,” assigning a duration the narration does not specify.

findings.highlight: maybe I’ll make some meat for dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 肉料理をメインにしてみるか
findings.governingReading: perhaps make a meat dish the main course
findings.explanation: The dinner plan loses both the dish category and its role as the meal’s centerpiece.

findings.evidenceJa: 意気揚揚と帰還しかけた足が止まる
findings.governingReading: his buoyant homeward stride comes to a halt
findings.explanation: The English keeps only an awkward stop and drops Shirou’s cheerful momentum toward home.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺気というか、敵意がまったく感じられない
findings.governingReading: he senses neither killing intent nor hostility from her
findings.explanation: mirror moon collapses the stronger and weaker threat signals into generic hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に嬉しそうな笑顔
findings.governingReading: a smile that looks genuinely delighted
findings.explanation: Size replaces the sincerity and emotion Shirou reads in Illya’s relief.

findings.evidenceJa: 一刀のもとに斬り伏せた怪物
findings.governingReading: the monster who cut him down with a single stroke
findings.explanation: A decisive near-fatal defeat becomes an unspecified wound.

findings.evidenceJa: 反射的に頭を下げる
findings.governingReading: he reflexively bows his head
findings.explanation: A physical, involuntary gesture becomes only the speech act it implies.

findings.highlight: that sad look on her face
findings.evidenceJa: 今にも泣きそうな顔
findings.governingReading: a face on the verge of tears
findings.explanation: Immediate vulnerability becomes generic sadness.

findings.evidenceJa: 不思議な発音するんだね
findings.governingReading: you pronounce it strangely
findings.explanation: Illya comments on Shirou’s pronunciation; mirror moon changes the object of strangeness to his name.

findings.highlight: No. Emiya is my last name
findings.evidenceJa: 今の発音だと『笑み社』じゃないか
findings.governingReading: with that pronunciation it becomes “Emi-yashiro,” a smiling shrine or company
findings.explanation: The scene’s explicit missegmentation and written pun are deleted.

findings.highlight: Do you want to fight me right now
findings.evidenceJa: こんなまっ昼間からやりあおうってハラか
findings.governingReading: does she intend to fight starting in broad daylight
findings.explanation: The time-of-day violation motivating Shirou’s suspicion disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t mind going ahead with my plans
findings.evidenceJa: 予定がちょっと早まるだけ
findings.governingReading: it would only move her plans forward a little
findings.explanation: Illya’s cold statement of timing becomes another expression of willingness and loses “only” and the limited acceleration.

findings.evidenceJa: コウエイに思ってよね
findings.governingReading: you should consider it an honor
findings.explanation: Illya’s proud demand that Shirou feel honored becomes ordinary gratitude.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she means by “all this time”
findings.evidenceJa: 何が“それぐらい”なのかわからない
findings.governingReading: he does not know what her “that much” refers to
findings.explanation: The English points Shirou’s confusion at how long she waited instead of Illya’s claim that she deserves at least this conversation.

findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐに俺の顔を見上げてくる
findings.governingReading: looks straight up into his face
findings.explanation: The upward child-adult staging becomes symmetrical eye contact.

findings.evidenceJa: 全力でイリヤの申し出を拒否するだろう
findings.governingReading: Saber would reject Illya’s offer with all her force
findings.explanation: Saber’s categorical, forceful refusal becomes mere clarity of objection.

findings.evidenceJa: 舞うように走り出す
findings.governingReading: Illya sets off running as though dancing
findings.explanation: Her exuberant, weightless movement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: この理解不能のお嬢さん
findings.governingReading: this incomprehensible young lady
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic description of Illya disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 人をぶった斬っておいて
findings.governingReading: after cutting a person down
findings.explanation: The violent act motivating Shirou’s disbelief is generalized to an attack.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why, but I’m not mad
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない
findings.governingReading: he himself thinks it questionable or strange, but he is not angry
findings.explanation: Shirou judges his own lack of anger; mirror moon makes its cause merely unknown.

findings.highlight: I guess I’ll have to talk with her, just like she wants
findings.evidenceJa: こうして捕まってしまった以上、イリヤが望むようにのんびり話でもするとしよう
findings.governingReading: now that she has caught him, he decides to relax and talk as she wishes
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains obligation but drops the playful capture metaphor, leisure, and Shirou’s active decision.

findings.evidenceJa: 一時間ほど続いたと思う
findings.governingReading: he thinks it continued for roughly an hour
findings.explanation: Approximation and retrospective uncertainty become exact present-tense duration.

findings.highlight: Illya listens to my ordinary stories and meaningless talks
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは喜んで聞いていた
findings.governingReading: Illya listened with delight
findings.explanation: The emotion that gives the ordinary conversation its poignancy disappears.

findings.highlight: she has no doubt in that fact
findings.evidenceJa: マスターである自分を躊躇わない事
findings.governingReading: she does not hesitate over herself as a Master
findings.explanation: Illya’s lack of moral or emotional hesitation becomes mere certainty that she holds the role.

findings.highlight: as a result of their thousand-year-old history
findings.evidenceJa: 千年の執念の果てに
findings.governingReading: at the end of a thousand years of obsession or tenacity
findings.explanation: The Einzberns’ defining fixation becomes neutral institutional age.

findings.evidenceJa: 今までの時間が消え去ってしまうほどの、無感情な沈黙
findings.governingReading: an emotionless silence powerful enough to erase all the time they have shared until now
findings.explanation: The defining consequence of Illya’s withdrawal—the apparent annihilation of the preceding intimacy—is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 無邪気な少女のまま、ばいばい、と別れを告げる
findings.governingReading: still an innocent girl, Illya says “bye-bye”
findings.explanation: Her maintained childlike mode and spoken farewell are reduced to a gesture.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしはそうでもないんだけど
findings.governingReading: it is not as though she particularly wants to, she claims coyly
findings.explanation: Illya’s attempt to minimize her own desire is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 知ってる人だった
findings.governingReading: he was someone she knew
findings.explanation: Personal acquaintance becomes merely knowing about Kiritsugu.

findings.evidenceJa: 去っていく足音
findings.governingReading: the sound of departing footsteps
findings.explanation: An auditory, distancing transition becomes a visually asserted sprint.
